The glass is neither half full nor half empty.

Kevin Trudeau starts with a TV character who is broke and simply says he is "illiquid." That is reframing: changing how you describe your situation so you can act on it.

Then he gives the classic glass test. A true millionaire mindset says it doesn't matter whether the glass is half full or half empty, because you can always fill it up.

When did you last reframe a problem instead of complaining about it?
